notes.title: Update. Version 1.2
notes.content:
Update. Version 1.2. The game now supports devices on the LINUX operating system.

Also:
- - Updates the logic of artificial intelligence of enemies.
- Fixed minor and major bugs.
- Fixed a bug on level 4 and 12.
- The game's save system has been redesigned.
- Fixed texture errors on several levels.
- Additional optimization has been carried out.
- Fixed the Radial menu glitch at level 7.
- Added story content.
- Added animations.
- Added and changed sounds.

notes.title: February 24 update
notes.content: A lot of things have been redone and improved. + 7 months of development. Release soon!
